        Peace Games

        Choose a game and relax!

        🧒 Little Kids Corner

        Simple, gentle fun for little ones — big buttons, no reading needed.

        Finish a game to earn a treasure for your Peace Garden. 🌿

        🐦 Sound Match

        Listen closely… which nature sound is playing?

        Press play, then pick the sound you hear.

        Matches: 0 / 3

        🧩 Nature Puzzle

        Tap two tiles to swap them and rebuild the garden picture — sky on top, flowers at the bottom.

        🫧 Breathing Bubbles

        Breathe in as a bubble rises… tap it gently at the top to pop it. Pop 10 bubbles.

        Popped: 0 / 10

        🧱 Building Blocks

        Tap the big green button to stack a soft block. Stack them tall… then knock them down!

        Let's build something tall! 🧱

        🎨 Drawing

        Pick a color and draw with your finger. Big, easy, and all yours!

        Draw anything you like! 🌈

        🦋 Mindful Coloring

        Pick a color, then tap part of the picture to fill it in. No rules — just calm. Perfect for little fingers, too.

        Color at least 6 parts to finish.

        🔍 Find the Hidden Objects

        Three little friends are hiding in the meadow. Tap each one when you spot it!

        🌸 Memory Garden

        Tap the cards to flip them and find all 6 matching pairs.

        Sleep & Relaxation

        Drift into peaceful sleep

        Sleep Timer

        The sound fades away gently when time is up. Sweet dreams.
